title: SAVOY CHURCH BURNED — photo spread, Denison Herald, Feb. 23, 1954
text:
Page 10—THE DENISON HERALD—Tuesday, Feb. 23, 1954

[Photograph: Two before-and-after fire photos of the Savoy Church of Christ building. Top photo shows burned-out shell of the church structure with roof collapsed. The white-steepled building next door is visible and undamaged. Bottom photo shows a close-up of a church bell on the ground, and a portrait photo of a man in a hard hat.]

SAVOY CHURCH BURNED—A before and after the fire pictures of the Savoy Church of Christ are shown in the top pictures. The bell, at bottom, was located in the tower and came crashing through the floor at the height of the blaze. Mayor S. A. Bibby of Savoy is shown at right. He called the mass meeting after the fire that should get Savoy a fire fighting force.
(Staff Photos)
notes: Photo spread page. Three images: two showing the burned church ruins and one portrait of Mayor S. A. Bibby.
